title: Incomplete dominance: pink snapdragons
caption: Neither allele is completely dominant, so the heterozygote is intermediate. Two pink plants give 1 red : 2 pink : 1 white, so the genotype ratio and the phenotype ratio are the same, unlike the 3 : 1 of complete dominance.
alt: A Punnett square of two pink snapdragons: one red, two pink and one white offspring.
description: Each parent makes Cᴿ and Cᵂ gametes.
Offspring: CᴿCᴿ red, CᴿCᵂ pink (two squares), CᵂCᵂ white.
Genotype and phenotype ratios are both 1 : 2 : 1.
